Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 28-Dec-2025 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  EIGHTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE MAKEUP EXAMINATIONS - DECEMBER 2025  
  Advanced Computer Networks [CSE_5151H]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                   Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Drones in a high-speed delivery network frequently change positions and altitudes. Analyse the         (5)  
  suitability of AODV routing over DSR for maintaining stable connections.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           A forest monitoring system uses multiple drones to detect wildfires. Apply multi-UAV coordination to (5)  
  improve coverage and reliability.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2)                A smart manufacturing firm integrates numerous IoT devices that demand dynamic bandwidth               (5)  
  allocation. Examine how Software-Defined Networking (SDN) employs policy-driven control to  
  A)           enhance network responsiveness and optimize IoT device management  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)           A telecom operator deploys new services requiring multi-vendor compatibility. Apply open APIs and (5)  
  protocols like OpFlex to achieve interoperability and flexibility in SDN.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3)                A hospital's data centre faces inefficiency due to each application using a dedicated server. Analyse (5)  
  how moving from direct attached to shared storage over SAN improves resource use.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           A company wants to integrate compute, storage, and networking into a single platform. Apply the        (5)  
  concept of hyperconvergence to simplify infrastructure management.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4)                A content provider must serve videos efficiently to users across continents. Apply suitable CDN        (5)  
  deployment models such as "Enter Deep" or "Bring Home" to optimize global content delivery  
  A)           performance.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Users complain of distorted audio during peak traffic.                                                 (5)  
  Apply jitter buffering and adaptive playout strategies to stabilize voice quality.  
  
  
  Page #1

Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5)                        A network must guarantee bandwidth for VIP video calls while rejecting excess load. Analyse how     (5)  
  call admission control preserves QoS for existing users under limited capacity.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)                A telecom company expands its fiber backbone to support multiple high-speed services. Explain the (5)  
  WDM architecture that enables efficient bandwidth utilization and scalability in optical networks.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  
  -----End-----
